title: card-loop review result v1
description: Stage `review` (design D11/D12: a reviewer of the other family audits another attempt's worktree diff read-only; a reject is an immediate correction of that attempt). `verdict`: accept | reject. `directives`: on reject, each concrete change required (`path` repo-relative or null when not file-specific); may also carry non-blocking notes on accept. `summary`: one paragraph. Strict-mode compatible.
